real_product: P10 sidecar metadata for one prebound P11 day1 delivery; source payload bytes excluded
risk: unbounded metadata parse/store/list cost can exhaust the named intake budget; does not require a warehouse-wide member-count threshold
cost_boundary: check supplied caps on metadata counts, path bytes, serialized record/envelope bytes, enumerated event-dir files, committed store bytes and events; no market payload reads/rehash
configuration_scope: example for explicit dedicated one-purpose/day1 metadata root; not a shared multi-day warehouse store policy
unknown_bounds: counts/path limits pending exact consumer closure. Null stays explicitly unconfigured in Assessment.boundary_notes; no implicit1000 limit

outer_consumer_budget.owner: P11 actual intake; code above caps only the sidecar component, other metadata shares the same outer total. It does not enforce network/time or claim the complete delivery fits.

final_binding: member/evidence/path counts and actual sidecar byte share frozen by consumer config; policy remains nonactivated until source/M0/channel/pool closure
source_qualification: SOURCE_OBSERVED remains SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_UNBOUND in current isolated library, including plausible-looking URIs; real adapter not implemented
